answer: Give each agent a latency badge: verifiers on several continents ping it each epoch, and it must answer within tight deadlines, comet-fast past checkpoints. Ten identities on one summit of servers in one datacenter cannot fake ten distinct round-trip signatures at once, so every extra clone adds provable latency contradiction. An honest agent may answer from a shale-thin edge device anywhere; a sybil farmer must run real, always-on machines on several continents, turning free keygen into a hardware and bandwidth bill. Limitation: VPNs smear location, so this is a screening cost, not a proof.
